heuristic_underestimate.reason: Most feature_of weakness/pain rows are locally faithful; defects concentrate in high-stakes slots.

taxonomy.E1_subject_misattr: Quote is about another disease; subject is the focus or a hypernym.
taxonomy.E2_polarity_or_conditional_invert: Quote polarity or a conditional consequent is inverted.
taxonomy.E4_wrong_relation: Comparison, boilerplate, outcome rate, or definition written as required/sufficient/pathognomonic/excludes.
taxonomy.E5_scope_collapse: this variant/this form lifted to the parent class.
taxonomy.E6_context_strip: AIN appears as a spared contrast in another injury; extracted as AIN's own criterion.
taxonomy.E7_vacuous_or_epidemiology_as_criterion: Empty predicate, incidence-no-difference, or thesis sentence used as a diagnostic rule.
taxonomy.E8_misdiagnosis_or_mimic: Misidentification/mimic sentence written as excludes or as feature_of the mimicker.
taxonomy.E9_spurious_group: or collapsed to all; optional finding forced into conjunction; unrelated body-part in any-group.
taxonomy.E10_treatment_as_diagnostic_required: Surgical indication or failed conservative therapy written as required_for diagnosis.
taxonomy.E11_faithful_offtopic: Tuple is locally faithful but the subject is not the AIN/NA question this vignette asks.
taxonomy.OK: Faithful to the quote as written.
taxonomy.BOUNDARY: Quote-true definitional boundary; questionable as a diagnostic exclude.
